sources: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions (PlayStation) and cross-checked against the published guides of PSNProfiles, PowerPyx and Exophase; hour estimates are this guide's own, from the counter sizes on the official list.

steps.text: Play Chapters 1–4 and the final mission in order. Three things to do on the way, all flagged in the tracker: (1) in your first free hour on Ocean Beach, order the cocktail for In The Beginning…; (2) during the VCIA story visits, above all VCIA Takedown, leave by stolen plane for Catch Me If You Can; (3) keep a separate manual save at every chapter break and before every late-game choice for Actions Speak Louder. Do not grind anything else yet: the story fills most counters a little and unlocks everything the later steps need.
steps.title: The story, with three small detours
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Finish the stranger strands (8 needed for Strangers & Freaks; the named five — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone — each carry their own trophy) and sample every activity type once for Master of None. Clear the quick activity wins as you meet them: Cal's fishing challenge, one full arcade game, a bowling game at Kolt & Associates (which also feeds Let's Go Bowling), and Bret's unique-animal hunt.
steps.title: Strands and the activity tour

steps.text: The skill block. Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges for The Shootist, learning each course on a silver run first. Win 20 different races, win the Top Fun drone race at every location, and start the 250-stunt counter in earnest, sweeping stunt spots region by region; leave the last stunts to overlap with the collectible sweep's travel. Use this step to also force Bad Luck, I Guess: post a low range score, then beat it on the retry.
steps.title: Medals, races and stunts

steps.text: One region-by-region pass over Leonida collecting everything at once: 3 full card sets (and the rest of the deck for the 100% tracker), WAiNK machines toward the 100 locations, every meditation spot, vehicles toward 100 discovered, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, and the map itself for The Goodtime State. A helicopter makes the exploration and stunt leftovers painless. The platinum for patience: keep the tracker's counters open as you travel.
steps.title: The collectible sweep

steps.text: The robbery circuit: 5 bank vaults, an armoured truck, one illegal operation per gang, and a clean stealth jewelry robbery. Launder Marked Bills after every job (the $250,000 laundering counter only tracks cleaned money), then spend the proceeds: $100,000 of shop spending and every garage property. The partner feats belong here too, while you are rich and mobile: the 4-star escape with your partner and the 3-shop back-to-back chain.
steps.title: Money and crime

steps.text: The one-off miscellany: 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus, the Rhino rampage, the showroom-glass exit, the melee drive-by on the boardwalk, 50 challenges claimed from the challenges page, the partnership stat topped out, and a clear night in the Grassrivers for the UFO. None of these is missable; all of them are short once you know the trick, which each trophy's guide spells out.
steps.title: Feats and Easter eggs

steps.text: Open the completion tracker and close the gaps: it lists every category's percentage, so work the lowest category first. Stragglers are usually the last collectible set, an unfinished strand and one activity type never golded. When the tracker reads 100%, A Long Road unlocks — and with it, if everything else is done, Vice Got a Price! and the platinum.
steps.title: 100% and the platinum

summary.difficulty: 4 / 10 — no skill wall; the two medal and counter grinds (Shooting Range golds, 250 stunts) are the only long hauls.
summary.hours: 85–110 hours for the platinum, most of it the 100% completion tracker.
summary.missables: 3 flagged of 55: Actions Speak Louder (choice-locked), Catch Me If You Can (VCIA departure), In The Beginning… (opening-hours cocktail). Everything else can be cleaned up after the credits.
summary.online: None. The official list has no online trophies; the 'partner' trophies use the second protagonist in single player.
summary.playthroughs: 1 story playthrough plus free-roam cleanup. Mission replay and post-game free roam cover everything except the flagged choice trophy.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
